title: In-Model Context Compression with Agentic Soft Tokens for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_zh: 基于智能体软令牌的模型内上下文压缩方法，用于长程LLM智能体

paragraphs.en: 提出无需训练的智能体软令牌压缩方法ASTC，将长程任务上下文压缩为软令牌，减少计算且保持准确率。 Long-horizon LLM agents play an important role in solving complex and sustained tasks, with ever-growing interaction contexts. However, these accumulated contexts will raise substantial computational cost and obscure key decision-relevant evidence. Existing methods typically train external compressors or context-management agents to rewrite context as shorter hard-token sequences, but such external selection may not align with the LLM's evolving representation and is necessarily lossy. In this paper, we introduce Agentic Soft-Token Compression (ASTC), a training-free compression method using soft tokens within LLM agent for long-horizon tasks. Specifically, ASTC uses the model's native recurrent dynamics to determine the already absorbed information, leveraging the commonly-used hybrid Gated Delta Network (GDN)-attention. It then carries this information forward as agentic soft tokens while retaining exact values as hard tokens. The resulting compact sequence reduces later-layer computation and yields reusable KV caches, extending the savings across the agent's trajectory. Extensive experiments on long-horizon tasks show that ASTC matches or exceeds the uncompressed agent's accuracy with up to 50.68% fewer end-to-end Attention Pairs, while trained compressors require 15.4 to 103.7 times more Attention Pairs per successful task. These findings highlight agentic soft tokens as a model-native way to carry absorbed context forward as the task representation evolves.
paragraphs.zh: 提出无需训练的智能体软令牌压缩方法ASTC，将长程任务上下文压缩为软令牌，减少计算且保持准确率。长程LLM智能体在解决复杂且持续的任务中发挥着重要作用，其交互上下文不断增长。 然而，这些累积的上下文会带来大量计算成本，并使与决策相关的关键证据变得模糊。 现有方法通常训练外部压缩器或上下文管理智能体，将上下文改写为更短的硬令牌序列，但这种外部选择可能与LLM不断演化的表征不一致，并且必然是有损的。 在本文中，我们提出了智能体软令牌压缩（ASTC），这是一种无需训练的压缩方法，在面向长程任务的LLM智能体中使用软令牌。 具体而言，ASTC利用模型原生的循环动态来确定已经吸收的信息，借助常用的混合门控增量网络（GDN）-注意力机制。 随后，它将这些信息以智能体软令牌的形式向前传递，同时以硬令牌的形式保留其精确值。 所得到的紧凑序列减少了后续层的计算，并产生可复用的KV缓存，使节省的效果贯穿智能体的整个轨迹。 在长程任务上的大量实验表明，ASTC能达到甚至超过未压缩智能体的准确率，同时端到端注意力对最多减少50.68%，而经过训练的压缩器在每完成一个成功任务时需要多消耗15.4到103.7倍的注意力对。 这些发现凸显了智能体软令牌作为一种模型原生的方法，能够在任务表征演化的过程中将已吸收的上下文向前传递。
